page.content:
Warm western-boundary current that leaves the Gulf of Mexico for the North Atlantic.

How Gulf Stream connects

  • Character: Matthew Fontaine Maury — Maury compiled the pilot charts that mapped the Gulf Stream for navigators.
  • Topic: Thermohaline circulation — The Gulf Stream is the swift surface limb of Atlantic overturning.

What is Gulf Stream?

The Gulf Stream is the swift current Maury charted and Franklin popularized, a limb of the Atlantic circulation that carries heat toward Europe.

Key threads lead to Matthew Fontaine Maury and Thermohaline circulation.
